name: Submarine depth-keeping: instability and what the controller commands
description: Illustrative submarine whose hull is more compressible than seawater (depth equilibrium unstable): open loop after a 1500 kg extra mass, a PID commanding the target trim-tank mass (pump as a rate-limited servo) and the same PID commanding the pump flow, each with the eigenvalues of its closed loop, plus gains placed on the linear model (examples/control/submarine_depth.py); and the initial stability of a box barge with a slack tank.
